thread:
Maya Tran: hey team — i'm stuck at the airport, flight delayed 3+hrs :airplane: i'm primary for the overnight window and the pager just lit up for acme-search (latency surge). can someone take primary now? i'm still reachable but won't be able to jump on calls.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High P99 latency for tenant=acme-search on model=redwood-ggml-7b | p50=120ms p95=480ms p99=630ms error-rate=0.8% | triggered at 2024-09-12T02:12:30Z

Samir Ahmed: @Maya Tran sorry to hear — i'll take primary if @Leigh or @Raj can shadow for the next hour then I can fully pick up. what's the current impact? any customer-facing errors?

Maya Tran: no 5xxs, just elevated tail latency causing slow product flows for a subset of queries (search/autocomplete). support already flagged slow UX for a big customer. i left my notes in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-surge - see mitigation checklist.

Leigh O'Connor: ack. stepping in as secondary for now. Samir, want me to flip traffic to the quantized variant (ggml-q4) for acme-search? that reduces quality slightly but cuts latency.

Raj Patel: i'll be standby for infra ops. quick telemetry peek: looks like a sudden token-length spike + one replica degraded (OOM evictions). probable cause: a few large batched requests hitting a hot replica.

Samir Ahmed: ok plan: 1) remove bad replica from pool, 2) scale up pool by +2 for headroom, 3) roll traffic to ggml-q4 for affected route, 4) monitor key metrics.

Raj Patel: executing step 1 & 2 now. using rbctl (internal):
```
# remove replica (drain)
rbctl drain --replica-id r-az3-17 --pool acme-search
# scale pool +2 desired instances
rbctl scale --pool acme-search --delta 2
```

deploy-bot: Deployment event queued: scale request accepted for pool=acme-search, desired_delta=2 (requestor=Raj). Estimated warm-up ~45s.

runbook-bot: Runbook reminder: latency-surge -> fallback_quantized_variant step. See snippet: 'If p99>500ms for 5m and error-rate<2% then route to Q4 variant'

Leigh O'Connor: i'm going to start the traffic switch for the affected route. will do a 10% -> 50% -> 100% ramp with circuit-breaker watch.

Maya Tran: thanks all — tagging @support-escalations so they can message customer proactively. i'm going to update the oncall calendar to reflect Samir as primary for the remainder of my shift.

Samir Ahmed: starting 10% traffic to q4 now:
```
rbctl route update --route /v1/generate?tenant=acme-search --variant ggml-q4 --weight 0.1
```

incident-bot: NOTE: p99 reduced to 320ms after initial traffic split. continuing to monitor.

Leigh O'Connor: scaling completed (2 nodes added). one drained replica showed repeated GC spikes; captured logs and created infra-ticket #INF-4721.

Raj Patel: infra ticket attached stacktrace: "OOM while allocating KV cache block". workaround: reduce max_cache_size for that pool to avoid OOM thundering. applying config tweak now.

Samir Ahmed: ramping to 50% variant now.

Maya Tran: quick heads up — i'm officially handing primary to @Samir Ahmed for the rest of my shift. leaving checklist: monitor p99, ensure INF-4721 doesn't regress, update customer message draft: "We're seeing transient latency; we've routed to a low-latency variant while we stabilize; no data loss."

Leigh O'Connor: copy, i'll help with customer draft and stand by for rollback if quality complaints spike.

Samir Ahmed: on it. i'm updating the rotation sheet and adding a note: maya delayed outbound flight, primary handed to samir at 02:18Z.

incident-bot: UPDATE: metrics stabilized after full rollout to ggml-q4 for route acme-search p99=190ms p95=120ms p50=80ms. error-rate=0.6%.

Raj Patel: lowered max_cache_size on pool to 80% of default and restarted the degraded replica. it's healthy now.

Maya Tran: thanks team — appreciate the quick action. i'm reachable by DM if needed but handing off fully. :thumbsup:

Samir Ahmed: noted. i'm primary now. going to keep watch for 30m then reassess. tagging oncall-runbook-bot to attach post-incident notes.

oncall-runbook-bot: Post-incident checklist: capture timeline, add mitigation steps, mark if rollback required. Please fill in details in the ticket INF-4721.

Leigh O'Connor: added customer message draft to support thread and pinged account team.

Samir Ahmed: closing loop — p99 stable for 20m, no new alerts. leaving note on rotation: Samir primary (02:18Z->end-of-shift), Leigh secondary. thanks all.

Maya Tran: thanks again, everyone. safe travels when i finally get out of here :airplane:
